penalty: UCPD Art. 13(3): for widespread infringements, fines of at least 4% of annual turnover in the Member States concerned, or at least EUR 2,000,000 where turnover information is unavailable.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 4(a) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Generic environmental claim with no demonstrated excellent environmental performance.
rules.fix: Replace with the specific measured aspect, e.g. "outer shell is 62% recycled polyester, GRS certificate SGS-GRS-2025-114".

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 4(c) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Neutral / reduced / positive environmental impact claimed on the basis of emissions offsetting. Banned outright from 27 Sep 2026 - no evidence can cure it.
rules.fix: Delete the neutrality wording. State only emissions you actually cut, with the scope and the measurement method.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 2(a) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Sustainability label / score that is not based on a certification scheme and was not established by a public authority.
rules.fix: Name the certification scheme and the certificate ID, or remove the badge.

rules.msg: Claim about future environmental performance without clear, objective, publicly available and verifiable commitments, a detailed implementation plan and independent third-party monitoring.
rules.fix: Link the published plan with interim targets and name the independent expert that verifies it, or drop the pledge from product copy.
any: \bwe (will|aim to|pledge to|commit to|are on track to) be(come)?\b[^.]{0,40}\b(neutral|zero|sustainable|circular)\b

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 4(b) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Environmental claim about the whole product, range or business when it concerns only one aspect of it.
rules.fix: Scope the claim to the exact component or stage it was measured on.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 10 (scope extended by Dir. (EU) 2024/825)
rules.msg: A right or requirement that the law already imposes is presented as a distinctive feature of your offer.
rules.fix: State the statutory right plainly, without framing it as a bonus or a reason to choose you.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 23(d) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Durability claimed in usage time or intensity with no test or evidence on the page.
rules.fix: Cite the durability test standard and the result, or delete the claim.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 23(e) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Repairability claimed but the page carries no spare-parts, repair-manual or repairability-index information.
rules.fix: Add the spare-parts availability period and a link to the repair manual on the same page.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, point 23(f) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: Copy prompts the consumer to replace or replenish a consumable earlier than technically necessary.
rules.fix: Give the condition that actually calls for replacement, not a fixed calendar interval.

rules.clause: UCPD Annex I, points 23(g) and 23(h) (inserted by Dir. (EU) 2024/825 Art. 2(2))
rules.msg: A software update is presented as necessary. If it only enhances functionality this is banned, and any update that degrades the goods must be disclosed.
rules.fix: Say what the update changes and whether it affects existing functions.

rules.clause: UCPD Art. 6(2)(c) and Annex I, point 4 (Dir. (EU) 2024/825)
rules.msg: A benefit is advertised that is irrelevant or that the law already requires of every product in this category.
rules.fix: Remove it, or state it as background information rather than an advantage.

rules.clause: UCPD Art. 6(1)(b) as amended by Dir. (EU) 2024/825
rules.msg: Recycled content asserted without the share and the part it applies to.
rules.fix: Write the percentage and the component, e.g. "lining: 40% post-consumer recycled polyamide".

rules.clause: UCPD Art. 6(1)(b) as amended by Dir. (EU) 2024/825
rules.msg: An "up to" figure states the best case only and hides the actual share the buyer gets.
rules.fix: State the typical or minimum value, or give the range.
